author: steve__2005
body:
First of all, I want to say ty to the staff on this server for being so great unlike other servers. This gave me a great first experience here. 

Another thing is, Precise_  sort of helped me with this idea(More so agreed with it)

Idea1- In nebula make it so you can vote for the next map. But there are only 5 voting options and the last 3 rotations you played on are never in the voting thing, making it so you cant play the same maps over and over again. 

Idea2- For nebula at the end of the game so who the MVP of the game is(broke the most monuments/ had most kills) then show the mvps of each of the teams.

Idea3- After the idea 2 happens then in chat you see a small summery of what you did (Amount of kills/ monuments broken)

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Nice suggestions! The idea of rotations decided by players in a voting system sounds quite cool. Idea 2 sounds nice as well.

Also, regarding to Idea 3, you can now do /match to check your kills, deaths, and kill/death ratio for that particular match.

Gotta say no to voting for matches.

People will just vote for their favorite map, builders who have worked hard to get their map accepted won't get a chance to play theirs, it's unfair.

Idea 3, yeah duh. Maybe an option to turn it off if you don't want to look at bad you did.

Idea 2 would really be the person that killfarms the most, and the rusher thing is eh. Just cuz.
